title: Home Mortgage Loans: Schedule of Program Terms, Rate Type and Eligible Occupancy
content:
Each note Piedmont Crescent Bank issues under Home Mortgage Loans is written on one of six programs, and the program fixes the scheduled term of the note, whether the note rate is fixed or adjustable, the occupancy the secured property may be put to, and the number of loans of that same program one borrower may carry at once.

## Schedule of program terms

| Program | Scheduled term | Rate type | Eligible occupancy | Loans of this program one borrower may carry |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 360 months | fixed | primary residence | 1 |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 360 months | fixed | primary residence | 1 |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 360 months | fixed | primary residence, second home, investment | 3 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 180 months | fixed | primary residence, second home, investment | 3 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 360 months | adjustable | primary residence, second home | 2 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 360 months | fixed | primary residence, second home | 2 |

The count in the last column is the most loans of that program a borrower may carry in applied, active, delinquent or forbearance status.

## The same terms read across the programs

Five of the six programs are written over 360 months; only the Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage is written over 180 months. Five carry a fixed note rate; only the 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage carries an adjustable one. Occupancy narrows as the programs are read down the schedule: the two agency programs admit a primary residence alone, the two Conventional programs admit all three occupancies, and the adjustable and Jumbo programs admit a primary residence or a second home.

## Reading the occupancy column

Because the column states the occupancies each program admits, the programs open to a given occupancy follow from it. A property to be held as an investment can be financed on the Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage or the Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage, and on no other program. A second home can be financed on either Conventional program, on the 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage or on the Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage. A primary residence is admitted by every one of the six.
